parameters.description: ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down at the object's TOP SURFACE ONLY. Rectangular edges run horizontally and vertically on the canvas. Show no vertical front or side faces. One simple square deck-mounted spacecraft sulphuric acid storage tank, TOP SURFACE sprite only. Original coarse utilitarian pixel art suited to Ostranauts. The square tank's own flat slate-grey containment tray fills the ENTIRE square canvas opaque edge to edge; straight sage-grey rim along all four canvas edges, no surrounding floor. A single large rounded-rectangular sealed pale sage enamel tank lid nearly fills the tray. Plain broad unbroken enamel surface, a small flush circular filler cap near the upper left, one short copper-brown capped connection contained within the right edge. A few large dark slate fastening tabs, restrained scuffed paint at corners. Sparse and calm industrial storage design, unmistakably a sealed vessel rather than a processing machine. Limited desaturated palette, crisp pixel clusters and restrained even overhead shading. NO readings, NO gauges, NO fill strips, NO instruments, NO screens, NO lights, NO text, NO symbols, NO logos, NO people, NO visible contents, NO open holes, NO external pipes, NO floor, NO cast shadow, NO side walls, NO perspective.

generationLog.rejection: Padded assembly with visible surrounding floor and cast shadow; full-footprint rule failed.

generationLog.prompt: ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down at the object's TOP SURFACE ONLY. Rectangular edges run horizontally and vertically on the canvas. Show no vertical front or side faces. Generate ONE new original spacecraft sulphuric acid STORAGE TANK sprite using the supplied original Phobos image as a camera and square-footprint reference ONLY. Redesign the equipment itself. The image is the full square horizontal top assembly of the tank, opaque edge to edge with the tank's own square rim exactly touching all four image boundaries. No image margin. No surrounding floor or background. It is simple hardware for a worn-in industrial space survival game with the coarse, restrained, hand-painted pixel appearance of Ostranauts equipment. A broad sealed tank top of pale sage-grey protective enamel sits inside a square dark slate secondary containment bund. Make the tank lid a large softly rounded rectangle, taking up almost the entire area; a wide quiet uninterrupted sage surface. One small circular closed filler cap near the upper left, one capped short copper-brown connection on the right, tucked inside the square footprint. A thin slate seam around the enamel lid and four very simple recessed fixing blocks. Slate chassis and sage outer rim occupy the remainder of the canvas; they are the object's own fitted square structure, never floor. Materials read through a few broad tonal regions, restrained scuffs on the rim, subtle enamel chipping, gentle flat overhead shading. Plain, legible and solid storage; no machinery clutter, valves scattered around the lid, pipes winding around it or decorative greebles. No central turbine, reactor lid, process chamber or hatchwheel. No text, words, numbers, labels, logos, symbols, gauges, readings, screens, status lights, fill strips, exposed liquid or changing contents. No visible front/side faces, no perspective, no cast shadow. All edges parallel to the image axes. The new acid family is sage and slate with only a tiny copper connector; retain this understated original maker identity. Deliver a square high-resolution master, at least 1024 by 1024, designed to remain very clear when reduced to 32 by 32 pixels.
